title: kbmon ages an overlap from an older meeting of the same two sessions on intents they no longer announce, so a fresh overlap on new files enters needs-you at once
goal: the age of an overlap counts from the moment the two sessions met on the intents they announce now, not from an earlier pair of intents of the same sessions that no longer holds

run:
import sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import mon_sessions as m
now = time.time()
found = {'intents': [{'session': 'A', 'item': 'ST-ab12cd34', 'touch': '_tools/y.py'}, {'session': 'B', 'item': 'ST-ef56gh78', 'touch': '_tools/y.py'}],
         'intent_at': {'A': [(now - 10800, ['ST-aaaaaaaa'], ['_tools/x.py'], False), (now - 60, ['ST-ab12cd34'], ['_tools/y.py'], False)],
                       'B': [(now - 10790, ['ST-bbbbbbbb'], ['_tools/x.py'], False), (now - 50, ['ST-ef56gh78'], ['_tools/y.py'], False)]},
         'coordinate': [], 'dispatched': set()}
rows = m.overlap_rows(found, now) or []
age = rows[0]['age_s'] if len(rows) == 1 else None
print('overlaps', len(rows), '| age_s', age, '(the sessions met on the live files 60 s ago; the older meeting was on files they no longer announce)')
sys.exit(0 if age is not None and age < 600 else 1)
